scope: 6case,2 real-source tables x3seed. No algorithm expansion. This cannot promise that LLM is useful.

hospital.mechanism: 用授权教学合法值域内其他值替换，制造指标字段关系不一致；仅叫受控跨字段替换，不声称原始真实语义错误

flights.mechanism: 同字段合法时间替换、计划/实际字段混淆；同航班同来源结构保持；不把AM/a.m.格式差异当语义

data: 沿用对应seed实体分区，curator从原clean构建新脏输入并封存；仅30%所选字段可修改已知格、其余原目标格干净。参考空值排除；全部条件相同权限。不是原自然脏表，不是新blind。
frozen_algorithm: 124core和原运行适配字节复用，只换新ROOT、服务身份/端口；无新增LLM文本候选能力。现有学习预算保留：prior/context各5次真调用；nofeedback次数配对；三独立学习arm。
phases: owned service+sequential per-GPU native/source learning+standalone repair
one independent final scorer, then stratum and paired aggregation
unknown_failures: block scoring; preserve response/log/partial stage; no repeated calls or resplit to evade guards
measurements: candidate coverage only teaching until output freeze
decision_after_test: 若新增场景仍无LLM独立收益，如实报告当前边界；语义程序生成扩展另立版本与同能力确定性对照，不自动改旧方法/原表。
delivery: paper-style tables/PNG/PDF + precise scope/limitations, not a huge Excel-first presentation
